author: D.S.Littler & Littler, 1990

note.en: A tiny fan-shaped light green alga (under 1 cm) on hard reef bottom at Playa Chiquita at 2 to 5 m (added from literature).
note.es: Una diminuta alga verde clara en forma de abanico (menos de 1 cm) sobre fondo duro del arrecife en Playa Chiquita a 2 a 5 m (agregada de la literatura).

evidence: Vega-Álvarez et al. 2018: Playa Chiquita, Punta Cocles, 2 to 5 m

sources.t: Vega-Álvarez et al. 2018, New records of benthic marine macroalgae from the Caribbean coast of Costa Rica, Revista de Biología Tropical 66(S1)
